decisions.proposed_text: Chưa đáp ứng điều kiện tham gia, không thể đặt lịch cuộc đua
decisions.reason: 未满足 carries an explicit not-yet/unmet state; using Chưa restores that aspect while preserving the race-booking restriction.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded locked term race.generic requires 比赛 -> Cuộc đua, which is preserved.

decisions.proposed_text: Support Card đang được thiết lập
decisions.reason: Current text uses the forbidden literal Vietnamese label for 支援卡; the revision restores the required player-facing Support Card term.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.support_card and source-bridge system.support_card require Support Card and forbid Thẻ hỗ trợ.

decisions.proposed_text: Không thể chọn Support Card trùng lặp
decisions.reason: The current text drops the explicit 支援卡 object and therefore fails the required player-facing Support Card terminology.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.support_card and source-bridge system.support_card require Support Card and forbid Thẻ hỗ trợ.

decisions.reason: The translation faithfully preserves winning any debut or maiden/unwon race and is natural in this objective-style UI context.

decisions.proposed_text: Giành chiến thắng trong bất kỳ cuộc đua Pre-OP nào
decisions.reason: The source says any Pre-OP race and contains no numeric token; the current text introduces an unsupported digit 1.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded locked term race.generic requires 比赛 -> Cuộc đua, which is preserved.

decisions.proposed_text: Giành chiến thắng trong bất kỳ cuộc đua OP nào
decisions.reason: The source says any OP race and contains no numeric token; the current text introduces an unsupported digit 1.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded locked term race.generic requires 比赛 -> Cuộc đua, which is preserved.

decisions.proposed_text: Nhận cúp của các cuộc đua trọng thưởng
decisions.reason: The current wording omits the explicit 比赛/race concept; the revision preserves both the trophy objective and the required player-facing race label.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded locked term race.generic requires 比赛 -> Cuộc đua; current text does not satisfy it.

decisions.reason: Nguồn kế thừa is a direct, concise and natural rendering of 继承源 in this inheritance UI context.

decisions.proposed_text: Hạng 1 cuộc đua Chưa đăng quang
decisions.reason: The current wording is clipped and unnatural; adding cuộc đua restores a complete Vietnamese race-result label while preserving the source's rank 1 token.

decisions.proposed_text: Hãy chọn hai Mã Nương kế thừa
decisions.reason: Generic 赛马娘 must use the project world term Mã Nương; spelling out hai also avoids introducing a digit absent from the source.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.world.umamusume requires Mã Nương for generic 赛马娘 and forbids Uma Musume.
